text:
That friend of yours already went off to
challenge the next Gym.\c
Kabu’s League Card is supposed to help
against him, but I ended up with a few copies,
so I’ll give you one.\c
Don’t look so chuffed. It’s no big deal.[VAR 0114(000D)]
Hey, help with somethin’ for a sec. I want t’see if\nI’m ready for the next leg of the Gym Challenge.[VAR 0114(000D)]

Hmm... Looks like I’ll need to raise
Morpeko and the others a
little more.\c
Not much of a thank-you, but I can heal up
your team, at least.[VAR 0114(000D)]
Take this, too... A little somethin’ for our\nbattle yesterday.[VAR 0114(000D)]

Bet you’ll have no trouble beatin’ that
“man of fire” Kabu chap, right? Why don’cha get
over to Motostoke Stadium and get that
Gym Badge already?[VAR 0114(000D)]
